title: FeatureTable
description: Canonical pre-assignment feature table schema for model training, validation, and testing. Excludes all latent variables, potential outcomes, and outcome window aggregates.

tenure_days.description: Customer account age in days from signup to campaign assignment.

txn_count_30d.description: Total transaction count in the 30 days prior to assignment.

txn_count_90d.description: Total transaction count in the 90 days prior to assignment.

txn_amount_30d_bdt.description: Total transaction volume in BDT across prior 30 days.

txn_amount_90d_bdt.description: Total transaction volume in BDT across prior 90 days.

qr_txn_share_90d.description: Share of QR transactions over past 90 days: QR count / max(txn count, 1).

cashout_share_90d.description: Share of cash-out transactions over past 90 days.

merchant_pay_share_90d.description: Share of merchant-pay transactions over past 90 days.

days_since_last_txn.description: Days since last pre-assignment transaction. Defaults to 999 if no prior transaction.

avg_ticket_90d_bdt.description: Average transaction ticket size over past 90 days: amount / max(count, 1).

app_channel_share_90d.description: Share of transactions performed via app channel over past 90 days.

campaign_exposures_prior_30d.description: Count of marketing campaign exposures received in prior 30 days.

campaign_exposures_prior_90d.description: Count of marketing campaign exposures received in prior 90 days.

days_since_last_campaign.description: Days elapsed since the previous campaign exposure. Defaults to 999 if none.

objective.description: Marketing campaign objective known at decision time.

offer_type.description: Incentive structure offered by the campaign.

incentive_value.description: Incentive magnitude in BDT or percentage.

incentive_cost_bdt.description: Expected unit cost in BDT for targeting this customer.

treatment.description: Randomized treatment flag (1 for treated, 0 for control).

y_transacted.description: Factual conversion label observed in the 14-day outcome window.
